notes:
1. Fixed card-name declaration windows closing before their results were ready. Primite Roar and Mind Scan now allow repeated searches and returning to the name input with Cancel.
2. Selecting a card while Deck Builder search results change no longer opens an unrelated card or reports an error when the new results are empty.
3. A missing notification popup no longer interrupts a successful deck save or leaves the interface blurred. Ordinary notifications use the existing message display while the popup is unavailable.
4. Fixed MyCard profile-frame errors when an avatar is unavailable, still downloading, or cleared on logout.
5. Reading a new default setting no longer prevents Online or Solo screens from opening when the configuration file cannot be written. Explicit saving still reports write failures.
6. Failed duel input-popup loads now clean up their resources and report the original load failure without an additional popup error.
7. Fixed animated card-info tooltips producing excessive sprite tiles and mesh errors while opening or closing, preserving their full text and native appearance.
8. Opening a deleted or locked deck now keeps the current deck, unsaved edits and selection intact and shows a loading message. Decks in folders and launch-screen editing retain their normal behavior.
9. Added Linux-compatible versions of the bundled animated card artworks. Linux selects the supported video format while preserving custom artwork priority and other platforms' existing playback choices.
10. Queued character speech now keeps its original character, subtitle and expression while audio loads or waits. A failed audio part no longer shifts the remaining parts' subtitle and expression.
11. Fixed a false missing-card error when Machine Tokens created by Division finish cleaning up after leaving the field.
12. Fixed sound requests interrupting each other's loading and causing repeated duplicate-bundle errors. Sounds keep their pause and stop behavior while loading.
13. Restored the imported duel music for the Melffy and Toon World fields.
14. Fixed cards and deck stacks sinking beneath the Melffy field.
15. The duel-log button now closes the log when pressed again, while clicking outside still dismisses it.
16. The Master Duel engine now shows the Extra Deck's yellow Special Summon command button when a summon is available.
17. Finishing an opponent with an attack no longer restarts the duel music before the result effect.
18. Fixed missing pending activation choices in the Master Duel engine, including Gold Pride - Nytro Head's token effect during the opponent's Standby Phase.
19. Added six original card finishes: Halloween Lanterns, Haunted Night, Currency Rain with dollar and euro symbols, Bonfire Embers, Sunlight Covenant and Abyssal Eclipse.
20. Removed the retired Share command and its legacy deck-sharing links from the Deck Editor. Copy and YDKE import remain available.
21. Fixed the Master Duel engine sometimes leaving the first duel's deck unshuffled. Scripted tutorials and saved replays keep their intended order.
22. Face-up banished cards now keep their revealed picture while returning to the Deck in Master Duel engine duels.
23. Removing a card by dragging it from Deck to Stash now immediately rearranges the remaining cards, including the transition from 41 to 40 cards.
24. Evolution campaign actions now use a two-column, two-row area below Gate Details, with Campaign Decks beside Play.
25. Public hand-card activations in Master Duel replays now display their artwork in the card-info panel instead of leaving a black loading image.
26. Fixed kicking an AI bot after the room host switches from Duelist to Spectate.
27. Duel timers now wait for queued presentation and usable response controls, and stop as soon as a choice is sent. LAN servers on Windows, Android, Linux and macOS now keep presentation time separate from the response clock.
28. Added 36 Duel Masters card finishes, including rainbow foil, foil-stamp sparkles, premium foils and animated frame treatments. Select them in Card appearance under Finish; each deck copy can keep its own finish across card layouts.
message: Small update steps start at 1.0.4. Original baselines (Windows/Android 1.0.0; Linux/macOS 1.0.2) retain their direct patch to 1.0.6. Other intermediate installations below 1.0.4 require a full installation; see the Workshop guide. Reopen MDPro4 and check again after each staged update.
